transactioncolumncustomfield.description: How much this line came up SHORT - what the order still had outstanding minus what the device actually received or fulfilled. Written by the RapidBridge inbound write RESTlet on every line it creates, ZERO INCLUDED: a blank means the line predates this field, not that nothing was short. Exception Reason says why and Exception Note says it in prose; neither can be totalled, filtered or compared against what TrackTraceRX expected, which is what this is for. On an item eligible for TrackTraceRX a shortfall must carry a reason or the submission is refused - an unexplained discrepancy on a regulated product cannot be reconciled afterwards.
